verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers file import, search, sharing, versioning, and MCP/CLI integrations, but contains no documentation on data retention policies, permanent deletion, or export/purge controls for an AI-native privacy-conscious user. Community comments raise general trust/security concerns but don't confirm or deny specific retention/deletion mechanisms. missing for 10: retention policy docs, account/file deletion controls, data export or purge guarantees, any first-party statement on how long data is kept or how to fully erase it.
